name: Search & Replace for Elementor – Find Replace Text, Links & Images in Elementor Pages
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Search and replace in Elementor instantly with Search & Replace for Elementor – the Elementor addon that finds and replaces text, links, and images directly in the Elementor visual editor.

Elementor lacks built-in search and replace functionality. Search & Replace for Elementor fills this gap by adding instant find-and-replace for Elementor pages. Search for any text, link, or image in Elementor content, replace with one click, highlight matches visually, and use keyboard shortcuts (Alt+Shift+F) for quick access. Works with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Whether you’re updating URLs across Elementor pages, fixing typos in Elementor text, or replacing images in Elementor layouts, this addon makes Elementor search and replace fast and visual.

Why Choose Search & Replace for Elementor?

  • Elementor Search & Replace – Find and replace directly in Elementor editor
  • Text, Links & Images – Search all Elementor content types
  • Visual Highlighting – See matches highlighted in Elementor pages
  • Keyboard Shortcuts – Alt+Shift+F to open Elementor search modal
  • Case-Sensitive Search – Precise Elementor find and replace control
  • Undo Function – Revert Elementor replacements instantly

How Elementor Search & Replace Works

  1. Install and activate Search & Replace for Elementor on your WordPress site
  2. Edit any page with Elementor editor
  3. Press Alt+Shift+F or click Menu > Search & Replace
  4. Enter search term to find in Elementor content
  5. Enter replacement text, link, or image URL
  6. Click Replace to update Elementor page
  7. Use Undo to revert if needed
  8. Click Clear to remove highlighting tags

Zero configuration required – works immediately with Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Perfect For

  • Web Designers updating Elementor pages with find replace
  • Agencies managing multiple Elementor client sites
  • Developers fixing URLs across Elementor pages
  • Content Editors correcting typos in Elementor text
  • Freelancers working with Elementor page builder
  • Site Owners maintaining Elementor websites

Elementor Search & Replace Features

Find and Replace in Elementor
Search Elementor page content for text, links, or images and replace instantly. Visual highlighting shows all matches in Elementor editor before replacement. Works with Elementor widgets, sections, and columns – searchable directly in visual editor.

Elementor Text Search
Find any text in Elementor pages including headings, paragraphs, buttons, and custom text widgets. Case-sensitive and case-insensitive Elementor search options. Highlight matching text visually in Elementor editor for easy identification.

Elementor Link Replace
Search for old URLs in Elementor pages and replace with new links. Update affiliate links, change domains, or fix broken URLs across all Elementor widgets. No need to edit each Elementor widget individually.

Elementor Image Replace
Find image URLs in Elementor pages and replace with new images. Update CDN URLs, swap images across Elementor layouts, or fix broken image links. Visual search shows which Elementor images will be replaced.

Elementor Keyboard Shortcuts
Press Alt+Shift+F to instantly open Search & Replace modal in Elementor editor. Keyboard shortcut works anywhere in Elementor for fast access to find-and-replace functionality. Auto-focuses search input for immediate typing.

Elementor Visual Highlighting
All search matches highlight in Elementor editor with special tags. See exactly what will be replaced before clicking replace button. Clear highlighting tags with one click to restore original Elementor view.

Usage

Once the Elementor search and replace addon is installed and activated:

  1. Open any page in Elementor editor
  2. Press Alt+Shift+F keyboard shortcut or click Menu > Search & Replace
  3. Search & Replace modal opens in Elementor
  4. Toggle Highlight to visually mark matches
  5. Toggle Case Sensitive for precise search
  6. Enter search phrase in first field
  7. Enter replacement text/link/image in second field
  8. Click Search to find in Elementor content
  9. Click Replace to update Elementor page
  10. Use Undo link if needed
  11. Click Clear to remove highlighting tags

Here are the steps to use Search & Replace for Elementor:

  1. Open Modal – Press Alt+Shift+F in Elementor editor
  2. Enter Search – Type text/link/image to find in Elementor
  3. See Highlights – Visual markers show matches in Elementor
  4. Enter Replace – Type replacement for Elementor content
  5. Click Replace – Update all matches in Elementor page
  6. Use Undo – Revert Elementor changes if needed
  7. Clear Tags – Remove highlighting from Elementor

Note: Elementor addon works per-page. Bulk search and replace across multiple Elementor pages available in Pro version.

Elementor Search & Replace Settings

Using Keyboard Shortcut:
1. Edit any page in Elementor editor
2. Press Alt+Shift+F keys together
3. Search & Replace modal opens instantly
4. Search input auto-focuses for Elementor search
5. Start typing to find in Elementor content

Highlighting Matches:
1. Open Search & Replace in Elementor
2. Enable Highlight checkbox
3. Enter search term
4. Click Search button
5. All matches highlight in Elementor editor
6. Visual markers show exact Elementor locations

Case-Sensitive Search:
1. Open Elementor search modal
2. Enable Case Sensitive checkbox
3. Search matches exact capitalization only
4. Find “Elementor” differently from “elementor”
5. Precise control over Elementor replacements

Replacing in Elementor:
1. Search for term in Elementor content
2. Enter replacement in second field
3. Click Replace button
4. All Elementor matches update instantly
5. Page reloads to clear Elementor cache
6. Verify replacements in Elementor editor

Supported Elementor Content:
– Text widgets (headings, paragraphs, buttons)
– Link URLs in Elementor elements
– Image URLs in Elementor media
– All Elementor widget types
– Sections and columns

Features & Limitations

The Search & Replace for Elementor addon allows you to:

  • Search and replace text in Elementor pages instantly
  • Find and replace links in Elementor content
  • Replace image URLs in Elementor layouts
  • Highlight matches visually in Elementor editor
  • Use keyboard shortcuts (Alt+Shift+F) for quick access
  • Toggle case-sensitive search for Elementor
  • Undo replacements in Elementor immediately
  • Clear highlighting tags from Elementor content
  • Works with Elementor Free and Elementor Pro
  • Native-looking interface in Elementor editor
  • Search Elementor widgets, sections, columns
  • No database access required for Elementor

Elementor Search & Replace Components

Search Modal Interface
Integrated Elementor modal for find-and-replace operations. Native Elementor styling with tooltips, loading states, and smart button management. Keyboard shortcut support (Alt+Shift+F) for instant access in Elementor editor.

Visual Highlighting System
Marks all Elementor search matches with special tags directly in visual editor. See exactly which text, links, or images will be replaced in Elementor. One-click clearing removes all highlighting tags from Elementor content.

Elementor Content Scanner
Scans Elementor page data for text, links, and image URLs. Works with all Elementor widget types including text, headings, buttons, images, and custom elements. Searches Elementor sections and columns comprehensively.

Replace Engine for Elementor
Updates Elementor page content with replacements. Processes text strings, URLs, and image paths in Elementor data. Full page reload ensures Elementor cache clears for reliable preview updates.

Undo System
Reverts Elementor replacements with one click. Restores original Elementor content immediately after replace operation. Safety net for Elementor editing workflow.

Cache Management
Handles Elementor preview cache automatically. Full page reloads ensure consistent results for consecutive Elementor searches. Prevents cache conflicts in Elementor editor.

Known Limitations

Free version features:

  • Scope – Single page only (Bulk Elementor in Pro)
  • RegEx – Not supported (Regular expressions in Pro)
  • Backups – No backup system (Built-in backups in Pro)
  • URLs – Full URLs only (Partial URL replace in Pro)
  • Data Limit – 300kb maximum (Higher limits in Pro)
  • Dry Run – Not available (Preview before replace in Pro)
  • Custom Fields – Limited (Advanced options in Pro)
  • Priority Support – Community only (Direct support in Pro)

Detailed Documentation

Find step-by-step setup guides, video tutorials, Elementor search tips, and replacement best practices on the Search & Replace for Elementor Documentation page.

Search & Replace for Elementor Pro

If you’re using the free Elementor addon from WordPress.org and want Pro features, you can purchase the premium version on the Search & Replace for Elementor Pro website.

Here are some features included in the Pro version:

  • Bulk Search & Replace – Update multiple Elementor pages at once
  • Dry Run Preview – See changes before applying to Elementor
  • Regular Expressions – Advanced pattern matching for Elementor
  • Built-in Backups – Database backup before Elementor replacements
  • Partial URL Replace – Update portions of Elementor links
  • Custom Data Fields – Search additional Elementor metadata
  • Raw Page Data – Access complete Elementor page data
  • Import/Export – Database import tools for Elementor
  • Higher Limits – No 300kb restriction for Elementor pages
  • Priority Support – Direct email support for Elementor addon
  • Regular Updates – Early access to new Elementor features
sections.installation:
Installing the Elementor search and replace addon is straightforward. Contact support if you encounter any issues.

Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.2 or higher
– Elementor Free or Elementor Pro

Installation from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Search & Replace for Elementor
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Elementor addon ZIP file
  2. Upload the search-replace-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins in WordPress admin
  4. Activate Search & Replace for Elementor
  5. Verify Elementor is active

After Activation

  1. Edit any page with Elementor editor
  2. Press Alt+Shift+F to open Search & Replace modal
  3. Or click Menu > Search & Replace in Elementor
  4. Enter search term to find in Elementor content
  5. Enter replacement text/link/image
  6. Click Search to highlight matches in Elementor
  7. Click Replace to update Elementor page
  8. Use Undo if needed to revert Elementor changes

Quick Start:
1. Edit page in Elementor
2. Press Alt+Shift+F
3. Search and replace
4. Done!
sections.faq:
Visit the Support Forum to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within a few days.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

How to search and replace in Elementor?

Edit any page in Elementor, press Alt+Shift+F, enter search term, enter replacement text/link/image, and click Replace. All matches in Elementor page update instantly.

What’s the best Elementor search and replace addon?

Search & Replace for Elementor provides native find-and-replace functionality for Elementor pages with visual highlighting, keyboard shortcuts, and undo support. Works with both Elementor Free and Pro.

Does this work with Elementor Free?

Yes, Search & Replace for Elementor works perfectly with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro versions. Full compatibility with all Elementor widgets and layouts.

Can I replace links in Elementor?

Yes, search for old URLs in Elementor pages and replace with new links. Update affiliate links, change domains, or fix broken URLs across all Elementor elements without editing widgets individually.

Does this work with Gutenberg or Classic Editor?

No, this addon is specifically designed for Elementor page builder. For Gutenberg/Classic Editor, try our Block Editor Search & Replace plugin.

Can I replace images in Elementor?

Yes, search for image URLs in Elementor pages and replace with new images. Update CDN links, swap images across Elementor layouts, or fix broken image sources.

How to use keyboard shortcuts in Elementor?

Press Alt+Shift+F anywhere in Elementor editor to instantly open Search & Replace modal. Keyboard shortcut auto-focuses search input for immediate typing and Elementor searching.

Can I undo replacements in Elementor?

Yes, click the Undo link immediately after replacement to revert Elementor content to original state. Undo restores previous Elementor page data before replacement.

Does highlighting affect my Elementor page?

Highlighting adds temporary tags to Elementor content for visual feedback. Click Clear button to remove all highlighting tags and clean Elementor code. Tags don’t appear on frontend.

Can I search case-sensitive in Elementor?

Yes, enable Case Sensitive checkbox to match exact capitalization in Elementor search. Find “Elementor” differently from “elementor” for precise Elementor replacements.

How to bulk replace across Elementor pages?

Bulk search and replace for multiple Elementor pages is available in Pro version. Free version works on single Elementor pages.

Will this slow down Elementor?

No, Search & Replace for Elementor is optimized for performance. Modal loads instantly via keyboard shortcut. Full page reload after replace ensures Elementor cache clears properly.

What is the 300kb data limit?

Free version processes Elementor pages up to 300kb of data to prevent server timeouts. Pro version removes this limit for large Elementor pages.

Can I use regular expressions in Elementor search?

Regular expression (RegEx) support is available in Pro version for advanced Elementor pattern matching and complex find-and-replace operations.

Does this modify Elementor database?

Yes, Search & Replace for Elementor updates Elementor page data in WordPress database. Always backup before major Elementor replacements. Pro version includes built-in backup functionality.

How to clear highlighting from Elementor?

Click the Clear button in Search & Replace modal to remove all highlighting tags from Elementor content. Restores clean Elementor code without visual markers.

  • Security – Fixed regex handling for Elementor search
